text: DEFONEOS — DCMS — BBC & Public Service Broadcasting AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for DCMS BBC & Public Service Broadcasting. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DCMS × BBC × Public Broadcasting × Ofcom × Media Plurality DCMS — BBC & Public Service Broadcasting AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for DCMS — covering BBC Charter renewal, public service broadcasting regulation, Ofcom content standards, media plurality, local news sustainability, and cultural AI across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Broadcast 1. BBC Charter & Governance BBC Charter renewal process, mid-term review, governance framework. BBC Board oversight, Royal Charter compliance, BBC Annual Report scrutiny, and editorial independence safeguards across all BBC services. Regulation 2. Ofcom Broadcasting Regulation Ofcom Broadcasting Code enforcement, content standards, and licensing. PSB prominence regime, EPG positioning, and on-demand regulation under the Media Act 2024. Plurality 3. Media Plurality Framework Media ownership rules, plurality test, and merger scrutiny. Cross-media ownership limits, local media market health, and news provider sustainability assessment across UK media landscape. News 4. Local News Sustainability Local Democracy Reporting Service, news publishers bargaining code, and BBC Local News Partnerships. Community journalism support, local news deserts mapping, and public interest journalism funding. Streaming 5. On-Demand & Streaming Regulation VoD regulation under Media Act 2024, prominence for PSB players, and audience protection. Netflix/Disney+/Amazon Prime compliance, age verification, and recommendation algorithm transparency. Spectrum 6. Spectrum Management Ofcom spectrum allocation, 5G/broadcasting coexistence, and digital switchover planning. Spectrum pricing, auction design, and interference management across UK broadcasting infrastructure. AI 7. AI & Content Authenticity Deepfake detection, AI-generated content labelling, and synthetic media regulation. Content provenance standards, watermarking requirements, and AI in news production guidelines. Cultural 8. Cultural Heritage Media BFI film preservation, National Archives broadcast collections, and cultural AI. Digital preservation standards, media heritage access, and AI-powered cultural cataloguing. Sport 9. Sport Broadcasting Rights Listed events regime, Crown Jewels protection, and sports rights market. PSB sport access, streaming platform competition, and anti-siphoning protections for major sporting events. Digital 10. Digital Inclusion & Media Literacy Media Literacy Strategy, digital skills programmes, and online safety education. Algorithmic literacy, critical thinking curricula, and vulnerable audience protection across all demographics. Funding 11. Arts Council & Cultural Funding Arts Council England funding, National Lottery distribution, and cultural investment. AI-assisted grant assessment, impact evaluation, and equitable funding distribution. Accountability 12. Parliamentary & Public Accountability DCMS Select Committee, BBC/Ofcom annual evidence sessions, and FOI. Public value test, charter renewal consultation, and audience trust monitoring. 8 Transformation Priorities Priority 1 BBC Charter AI Governance Engine Charter renewal evidence compilation 12mo→8 weeks, public consultation analysis +90%. AI-powered sentiment analysis of 100K+ submissions, comparative international broadcasting benchmarking. Target: data-driven charter renewal proposals with full provenance. Priority 2 Ofcom Content Standards AI Monitor Content compliance checking lag 30 days→real-time, Code breach detection +75%.
